title: Sorting-bound external-memory weighted shortest paths
formal: Can exact single-source shortest paths in an arbitrary undirected graph with nonnegative weights be computed in \(O(\operatorname{Sort}(n+m))\) I/Os without a bound on the edge-weight ratio or a semi-external memory assumption?
